answer.reason: Mongolia has a relatively young population, and its 2023 share of population ages 65 and above is approximately 4.86%, matching option B rather than the much higher 8.73% in option A.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Population ages 65 and above (% of total population)', what value is listed for Mongolia (MNG) in 2023?

A. 8.73335843873912%
B. 4.8636009012415%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population ages 65 and above (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: A
